name: manual_589082
claim: LAN peer outbox flush is best-effort: if the target peer portal is unreachable, the queued file stays in the outbox until the peer comes back online or the operator clears it.

decisions.notes: lan_peer_assign.py flush-outbox returns partial failure when a peer drop fails; start.ps1 logs a warning and continues rather than treating the failure as fatal. The queued message will be retried on the next successful --lan-peer startup or coord_pulse tick.
